newsitem.title: UK: UK M0 rises to 25.498 bln stg in week to July 9.
newsitem.headline: UK M0 rises to 25.498 bln stg in week to July 9.

text.p: British M0 money supply rose to a provisional seasonally adjusted 25.498 billion stg in the week to July 9 from 25.458 billion the previous week, the Bank of England said.
On an unadjusted basis M0 fell to 25.615 billion stg from 25.678 billion.
Notes and coins in circulation fell to 25.340 billion stg on a seasonally adjusted basis from 25.400 billion the previous week and to 25.457 billion from 25.620 billion stg on an unadjusted basis.
